name: CMB
intro: CMB (A Comprehensive Medical Benchmark in Chinese) 是一个完全基于中文语言文化背景设计的综合性、多层次的医学基准。它旨在解决直接翻译英文医学评测所带来的文化和语境不符问题，全面评估大型语言模型在中文医疗环境下的知识水平和临床咨询能力。该基准不仅包含中医，还覆盖了所有临床医学专业和不同专业级别。
build_method: 考试题, 专家构建, 人工标注
metric: Accuracy, 流畅性, 相关性, 完整性, 医学专业度
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 领域特定, 零样本, 少样本, 思维链
scale: 280,839道选择题；74个复杂病例、208个临床问题
build_method_en: Exam questions, Expert Curation, Human Annotation
intro_en: CMB (A Comprehensive Medical Benchmark in Chinese) is a comprehensive, multi-level medical benchmark designed entirely based on Chinese language and cultural context. It aims to address the cultural and contextual mismatches caused by directly translating English medical evaluations, providing a thorough assessment of large language models' knowledge and clinical consultation abilities in the Chinese medical environment. This benchmark includes traditional Chinese medicine and covers all clinical medical specialties and various professional levels.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2308.08833. The paper builds CMB from two subsets. CMB-Exam is based on common Chinese medical qualification and coursework sources, especially Medtiku materials shared with permission; questions undergo deduplication, cleansing, manual OCR calibration, and removal of items flagged by comments as problematic or wrong. The final exam pool has 280,839 MCQs, with 400 questions per subcategory sampled for test and 10 for development; three medical specialists generate explanations for the development questions only. CMB-Clin starts from 108 official-textbook medical cases, screens out image-dependent, under-specified, and overly similar cases, retains 74 high-quality real cases with 208 questions, and reformulates them as examiner-candidate multi-turn diagnostic consultations. Evaluation combines CMB-Exam accuracy with CMB-Clin expert-aligned scoring over fluency, relevance, completeness, and medical proficiency.
